// diagnostic

E0323

`namespace` keyword not in Jet — use `module name { }` for in-file grouping (D-NAMESPACE1)

What

`namespace` keyword not in Jet — use `module name { }` for in-file grouping (D-NAMESPACE1)

Why

The registered parse rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0323

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0323: tests/ui/namespace_foreign_kw.stderr.

Error [E0323]: in-file grouping uses `module name { }`, not `namespace`
  --> tests/ui/namespace_foreign_kw.jet:1:1
    |
  1 | namespace utils {
    | ^^^^^^^^^
 Why: Jet has one spelling for in-file grouping: a named `module` block
 Fix: write `module mygroup { fn foo() { … } }` instead
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0323

Error [E0003]: expected a call, binding, assignment, or `return`, found `}`
  --> tests/ui/namespace_foreign_kw.jet:5:1
    |
  5 | }
    | ^
 Why: inside a function body, write a call, binding, assignment, or `return`
 Fix: e.g. print("hello") or x :: 1
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0003
